subject: words
title: Tricky words 4: days
about: The CKLA Unit 4 tricky words: the seven days of the week plus today, yesterday and tomorrow. Day names start with a capital letter because they are names.
tip: Point to the capital letter and say: a day is a name, so it gets a capital.

cards.note: ay says long a; capital S, it is a name
o says u, ay says long a; capital M, it is a name
ue says oo, s says z, ay says long a
say Wenz-day: the first d and second e make no sound, s says z, ay says long a
ur says er, s says z, ay says long a
i says its name, ay says long a
ur says er, ay says long a
o says u, ay says long a
ay says long a; er is regular
first o says u, ow says long o
